_note: Keys can be paper id, title substring, or paper link. String values are shown as takeaway. Object values can use takeaway and note.
High-Performance Reinforcement Learning: 还是用 CMA-ES 优化了 T-N 曲线和摩擦。
NeuralSim: Augmenting Differentiable Sim: 一个 NN 放入仿真器的工作，niuB。混合数学分析模型和对难以建模部分的 NN。
Learning Torque Control for Quadrupedal: 首个 torque-control locomotion 带实机。
Dynamics Randomization Revisited: A Case: 核心问题是 dynamics randomization 到底有没有用。

SRBTrack.takeaway: 本质是把高维人体动作先转换成低维、可解释、可仿真的 SRB 物理轨迹。
SRBTrack.note: 再用策略学习自适应脚步和接触，最后通过 CVAE 与 MMSTO 把这个物理轨迹重建为 COM、动量和脚接触一致的全身动作；可以理解为从运动学数据集导出动力学参考 motion。

Student-Informed Teacher Training.takeaway: 在教师 PPO 目标中嵌入动态更新的学生模型，让教师始终背负“学生能否学会”的约束。
Student-Informed Teacher Training.note: 这个设计让教师进化过程直接考虑后续蒸馏难度，最终蒸馏出既强大又鲁棒的感知控制策略。

zh.note: 阅读时要分清：前面的 retarget 是显式几何映射，不是另一个神经网络；神经网络是后面的 RL 跟踪策略。初始坐标变换由标准姿态自动算出，额外偏移由梯度优化学习。上层把当前仿真状态固定，只沿“误差 → 参考目标 → 几何参数”求导；实际重定向数据来自仿真执行轨迹。换机器人通常要重训这套策略与参数，而“一个策略覆盖大量动作”指同一个机器人上的动作泛化。

en.note: Separate the explicit geometric retargeting map from the RL tracking network. Nominal transforms are computed from reference poses, whereas extra offsets are learned by gradient optimization. Upper-level differentiation treats sampled simulated states as fixed and follows error → reference → geometric parameters; the retargeted data comes from actual simulated execution. Changing the robot generally requires retraining the policy and parameters; one policy covering many motions refers to motion generalization on the same robot.

zh.note: 工程启发：蒸馏接 RL 时，先检查价值函数是否适配当前学生，不急着更新 actor。本文加载教师 critic，冻结学生并预热 5000 次迭代；多任务奖励下，critic 看任务指示量，优势按组归一化。短时模仿保局部风格，长时指令训练覆盖与切换；GC-RSI 从与指令相近的参考状态起步。可迁移的思路是先处理估值失配与任务尺度，再放开策略更新，而不是把 5000 次迭代或 50:50 比例当成通用配方；文中未逐项消融这些细节。

en.note: Engineering takeaway: when switching from distillation to RL, check whether value estimates fit the current student before updating the actor. HuMBLE loads the teacher critic, freezes the student for 5000 critic-only iterations, conditions the critic on task identity, and normalizes advantages by group. Short imitation episodes preserve local style; long command episodes expand coverage and transitions; GC-RSI starts near command-relevant references. The transferable idea is to address value mismatch and task scales before actor updates, rather than treating 5000 iterations or a 50:50 split as universal settings; these details are not individually ablated.

zh.note: 阅读思考（针对 v1 §2）：任务优先结构不等于安全约束之间的优先级。安全约束通常并列施加，冲突时通过松弛与惩罚处理，并不意味着数值上平均分配；本文已读方法未明确建立随场景变化的严格安全优先级。可以研究按场景排序、逐级最小化约束违反量的分层优化，这是我们的扩展思路，不是作者已实现的贡献。CBF 松弛、离散执行与模型误差会影响严格保证；质心投影约束也不等于完整动态稳定性。版本说明：本卡片依据本地 v1；官方 v2（2026-10-14）已加入硬件实验并报告超过 1 kHz，尚未精读，不与 v1 结果混用。

en.note: Reading reflection on v1 §2: task priorities differ from priorities among safety constraints. Safety inequalities are generally enforced together and relaxed with penalized slack when conflicting; this does not imply equal numerical allocation. The reviewed method does not explicitly establish context-dependent strict safety priorities. Context-based ordering and lexicographic minimization of constraint violation are possible extensions discussed here, not contributions implemented by the authors. Slack, discrete execution, and model mismatch affect formal guarantees; CoM projection containment is not full dynamic stability. Version scope: this card uses the local v1. Official v2 (2026-10-14) adds hardware experiments and reports over 1 kHz; it has not been reviewed in depth and its results are not mixed with v1.

zh.note: 个人读后评价：“占坑感强”，低优先级保留思路。训练后调偏好确实形成可用接口，但 HLP 的主要对照只是固定等权，MAE 仅下降 0.47°（约 4.7%），表 2 未报告跨训练 seed 的波动或置信区间。缺少充分调优的固定权重、逐动作固定权重等对照，无法隔离动态调权本身的贡献；采样策略互不支配也不代表接近真实最优前沿。真机结果以人工调权案例为主，应与仿真 HLP 定量实验分开解读。本次没有系统核查新颖性，也未复现代码。

en.note: Personal assessment: feels like staking out a research niche; retain the idea at low priority. Post-training preference tuning provides a usable interface, but HLP is mainly compared with equal fixed weights and reduces MAE by only 0.47° (about 4.7%); Table 2 reports no across-training-seed uncertainty or confidence intervals. Without well-tuned global or per-motion fixed-weight baselines, the contribution of dynamic adaptation is not isolated. Mutual non-dominance among sampled policies does not establish proximity to the true optimal front. Hardware results mainly use manual tuning and should be distinguished from simulated HLP evaluations. Novelty has not been systematically audited and code has not been reproduced.

zh.note: 个人理解：可以把它看作对 PD 式“慢目标、快反馈”的扩展——让策略给出一个利用全身状态的线性反馈律，在两次参数更新之间仍根据最新 state 修正关节目标。需要区分网络/参数更新频率、目标角更新频率与底层 PD 频率；Spot 示例是离线参数序列按 15 Hz 更新、目标角按 30 Hz 闭环重算。反馈矩阵不是底层 PD 增益；低频能力依任务而定。另一条主线是 Jacobian 正则化，而 LPN 使它直接等于反馈矩阵的范数惩罚。

en.note: Personal interpretation: extend the PD-style slow-target/fast-feedback hierarchy by having the policy provide a whole-body linear feedback law that corrects joint targets using fresh state between parameter updates. Distinguish network/parameter, joint-target, and low-level PD rates: the Spot example uses offline parameter sequences updated at 15 Hz and closed-loop joint targets at 30 Hz. Feedback matrices are not low-level PD gains, and low-rate capability is task-dependent. The other main contribution is Jacobian regularization, which LPN reduces directly to a feedback-matrix norm penalty.

zh.note: 个人理解：这篇论文说明了冗余自由度的用处。更具体地说，在本文的任务代价和随机控制模型中，保留冗余能让各自由度互相补偿，避免为重现细节而付出额外努力和噪声；最小干预原则进一步解释了哪些偏差应纠正、哪些可容许。

en.note: Personal interpretation: the paper explains the usefulness of redundant degrees of freedom. Under its task costs and stochastic control models, redundancy enables compensation without spending extra effort and noise on reproducing movement details; minimal intervention further explains which deviations should be corrected and which can be tolerated.

zh.note: 个人理解：若“微调参考数据”指小幅修改参考运动的一份输入副本，这个说法是对的；原目标固定，encoder 与底层 BFM 参数不变。TTCO 本体可理解为冻结 BFM 外的采样式 MPC，CEM 的分布更新不是训练可泛化的 goal 修正策略。论文的辨识度主要在跨 BFM 的系统验证、计算预算分配模型，以及离线重标注与示范复用。阅读疑问：优化 command 在仿真滚动状态下评价，却与原示范图像和状态配对；残余轨迹误差可能造成条件错配。随机化和跟踪损失能缓解，但本文没有单独量化这一因素；下游成功率只能说明这些近似标签整体上仍有用。

en.note: Personal interpretation: modifying an input copy of the reference motion is a fair description of data-level adjustment; the original target and encoder/BFM weights remain fixed. TTCO itself is sampling-based MPC around a frozen BFM, and CEM distribution updates do not train a generalizable goal-correction policy. Its distinguishing contributions are cross-BFM evidence, compute allocation, and offline relabeling for demonstration reuse. Reading concern: commands evaluated at rolled-out simulated states are paired with original demonstration images and states, so residual trajectory error can create conditioning mismatch. Randomization and tracking costs can mitigate it, but the paper does not isolate its effect; downstream success shows that the approximate labels remain useful overall.

zh.takeaway: 先用多任务离线数据训练共享世界模型，再固定模型，在想象轨迹上反向传播回报，为每个任务快速训练独立策略；部署时直接出动作。
zh.note: 本次随读理解：两阶段训练，先用多任务离线数据学 WM，再固定 WM、为每个任务分别训练策略；多任务不是换随机 seed。固定权重不等于切断计算图，策略仍可利用模型对输入动作的导数。需要保留的风险：策略更新会改变状态–动作访问分布，可能利用模型误差；式（6）没有显式的数据分布距离约束或模型不确定性惩罚，短时域、正则化及数据起点只能缓解部分问题，单任务实验另有在线微调。平滑性改善优化并不意味着准确性可忽略，图 2 与图 8 说明预测误差更低未必得到更好的策略，而不是证明任意不准的模型也能用。与 SuperMimic 的对照：二者都通过冻结模型上的短时想象轨迹和末端价值训练策略；PWM 的主方案是离线预训练后提取各任务专家，SuperMimic 则循环采样、拟合模型和改进一个目标条件的人形跟踪策略。这是本次阅读比较，不代表已确认直接继承关系。

en.takeaway: Pretrain a shared world model on multi-task offline data, freeze it, and backpropagate imagined returns to quickly train a separate policy per task; deploy the policy directly.
en.note: Reading interpretation: two stages—fit the WM on multi-task offline data, then freeze it and train a separate policy per task; multiple tasks are not different random seeds. Fixed weights do not detach the computation graph, so action derivatives can still train the policy. Retain the distribution-shift concern: policy updates change state–action visitation and may exploit model errors. Eq. (6) contains no explicit data-distribution distance constraint or model-uncertainty penalty; short horizons, regularization, and dataset starting states mitigate only parts of the problem, while single-task experiments additionally fine-tune online. Smoothness can improve optimization without making accuracy irrelevant: Figs. 2 and 8 show that lower prediction error need not yield better policies, not that arbitrary model errors are harmless. Comparison with SuperMimic: both train policies through short imagined rollouts of a frozen model with terminal-value bootstrapping. PWM mainly extracts task experts after offline pretraining; SuperMimic alternates data collection, model fitting, and improvement of a goal-conditioned humanoid tracker. This is a reading comparison, not an established claim of direct methodological inheritance.

zh.note: 个人理解：策略优化主干可看作 SHAC 式短视野可微 actor–critic，本文辨识度主要在在线学习的共享动力学、规模效率分析和真机部署。8 步是模型拟合窗口，32 步是策略想象视野，两者都属于训练。critic 补足窗口外回报，GAE 构造固定的价值拟合目标，actor 直接对模型回报求导。我们补充讨论的贝尔曼收缩针对固定策略下的理想算子：它缩小整体最大误差，不保证每个状态单调变准，也不能直接保证神经网络、世界模型和变化策略组成的系统收敛。速度任务当前只更新 encoder；先训练并冻结底层 decoder 再训练接口是合理候选，但论文没有完成与联合更新的对照。当前 decoder 仍由跟踪任务更新，因此作者所说并行与顺序训练相同，不宜理解成训练过程严格数值等价。

en.note: Personal interpretation: the policy optimizer is a SHAC-style short-horizon differentiable actor–critic; the distinguishing evidence concerns online shared dynamics, scaling efficiency, and hardware transfer. Eight steps define model fitting and 32 define policy imagination, both during training. The critic supplies the tail return, GAE constructs fixed value targets, and the actor differentiates model return directly. Our supplementary Bellman discussion concerns an ideal operator under a fixed policy: contraction reduces the maximum error across states, not every state monotonically, and does not directly prove convergence with neural approximation, a learned model, and a changing policy. Velocity reward currently updates only its encoder. Training an interface after freezing the low-level decoder is a reasonable alternative, but joint decoder updates have not been compared. Since tracking still updates the decoder concurrently, the authors’ equivalence statement should not be read as strict numerical identity of the two training schedules.

zh.note: 本次复习重点是 MCA：人类手腕提供几何初值，物体运动与近似质量/惯量提供力学需求，固定锚点求力、固定力调锚点，最后由机器人运动学把手的接触支撑点贴到固定物体局部目标。MCA 中移动点改变的是力臂；它没有在仿真器里试抓，也没有更新机器人关节。另一个要分清的层次是：均匀邻居权重决定拉普拉斯坐标如何计算，STR 的时空权重决定哪些坐标残差更重要，MCA 决定接触目标放在哪里。阅读评价：STR 是前端参考优化，STRL 仍是 PPO mimic 框架上的采样与奖励增强；这只是方法定位，不代表已经严格证明贡献大小。尤其不能把接触收益直接认定为 MCA 力学精修的独立贡献：w/o spatial 同时删除了部位加权及接触位置、方向目标。应在相同权重、方向目标、接触激活及求解预算下对比初始几何锚点与精修锚点，再在相同锚点下单独去掉部位权重。

en.note: MCA is the focus of this reading: human wrists initialize geometry; source object motion and approximate mass/inertia specify mechanical demand; fixed anchors give forces, then fixed forces guide anchor movement; robot kinematics finally aligns geometric hand support points with fixed object-local targets. Moving anchors changes moment arms. MCA does not run simulator grasp trials or update robot joints. Keep three layers separate: uniform neighbor weights define Laplacian coordinates, STR residual weights prioritize those coordinates, and MCA selects contact targets. Reading assessment: STR optimizes references upstream, while STRL augments PPO mimic sampling and rewards; this positioning does not prove relative contribution sizes. In particular, contact gains cannot be attributed independently to mechanical refinement: w/o spatial also removes part weighting and both contact objectives. Compare initial versus refined anchors at fixed weights, direction targets, activation, and solver budget, then separately remove part weighting at fixed anchors.

zh.note: 本次随读定位：这是参考轨迹的物理修正加 PPO mimic 流程。DSMS 使用已有 MuJoCo 动力学，优化 X、U；随后固定参考训练策略，两阶段没有描述端到端梯度或联合更新。MS 的关键是增加独立状态节点与连续性约束，可利用参考初始化状态；SS 则通过递推消去中间状态。接触隐式来自仿真器内部求解接触，SS 也可使用这样的转移模型。审稿疑问：现有 SRB/KD/DSMS 与重定向比较支持整体流程，却未在相同模型、代价、控制参数化与预算下直接隔离 SS→MS 的收益；滚动时域缩短窗口的效果也应分开验证。个人评价偏方法组合与系统验证，算法新颖性仍需更直接的对照；这不是完整文献优先性结论。SRB 只是一个上游来源，单刚体轨迹不能唯一确定全身姿态；正文只说明逐帧 IK，未展开其目标、冗余解选择或完整约束。

en.note: Reading interpretation: physics-based reference repair followed by PPO mimic training. DSMS optimizes X and U through existing MuJoCo dynamics, then freezes references for policy training; the described stages do not jointly update through end-to-end gradients. MS adds independent state nodes and continuity constraints and permits reference-state initialization; SS eliminates intermediate states through rollout. Contact-implicit handling comes from the simulator and can also be used in SS. Review concern: SRB/KD/DSMS and retargeting comparisons support the overall pipeline but do not isolate SS versus MS at matched dynamics, costs, control parameterization, and compute budget; shorter receding horizons should be separated as another factor. My assessment emphasizes method integration and system validation, with algorithmic novelty needing more direct evidence; this is not a complete literature-priority audit. SRB is only one upstream source, and a single-body trajectory cannot uniquely specify whole-body posture. The text mentions frame-wise IK without detailing objectives, redundancy resolution, or the full constraint set.

zh.note: 本次随读理解：先用接触概率选择可信支撑脚，再由脚高度、倾角及正向运动学重建仿真回放的初始基座状态；之后回放真实命令，用 UAN 位置目标残差对齐运动。接触标签用于构造回放起点，不是逐帧强制接触序列。“world model”是物理仿真器与 UAN 的组合。与 2025 年 UAN、ASAP 同属输入残差校准路线，本文明确强调的新增部分是仅靠本体感知实现接触一致初始化；不能仅凭“世界模型”名称判断新颖性。轨迹匹配学到的是有效修正，不保证唯一分离执行器误差与其他建模误差。

en.note: Reading interpretation: contact probabilities select trustworthy stance feet; predicted foot height/tilt and forward kinematics reconstruct the initial base state for simulation replay. Recorded commands are then replayed with UAN joint-target residuals to align motion. Contact labels construct resets rather than impose a contact sequence at every step. The world model is the physics simulator combined with the UAN. This shares the input-residual calibration route of 2025 UAN and ASAP; the stated addition is contact-consistent initialization from proprioception alone, so the world-model label does not establish novelty. Trajectory matching learns an effective correction and does not guarantee unique separation of actuator error from other modeling errors.

zh.note: 本次随读理解：给任务奖励，让策略在仿真中试错，自己学出先搜索接触再操作；没有示范动作数据集，也没有逐步教搜索顺序，但奖励包含靠近目标、接触和平衡等引导。PD 跟踪偏差不是额外传感器，上一时刻动作与当前关节状态已经允许网络利用负载变化。要区分三条训练线：主策略用 PPO；独立状态估计器用仿真物体真值监督；教师—学生 DAgger 是表现较弱的对照。非对称 critic 的特权输入不等于向 actor 提供物体真值。

en.note: Reading interpretation: task rewards and simulation trial and error let the policy learn to seek contact before manipulating. There is no demonstration-action dataset or labeled search sequence, but rewards include target-approach, contact, and balance shaping. PD tracking deviations require no additional sensor: previous actions and current joint states expose load-dependent changes. Separate three training paths: PPO for the main policy; simulator-state supervision for an independent estimator; and teacher–student DAgger as a weaker comparison. Privileged inputs to the asymmetric critic do not expose object truth to the actor.

zh.note: 随读理解：直接改的是环境模型对输入导数的学习及其在 actor 反传中的使用，不是事后纠正一个已算出的策略梯度。可以联系 Sobolev training，但值与导数联合监督、随机投影和有限差分已有先例；本文的辨识度在模型误差到策略优化的理论联系与双模型使用方式。保留的疑问：若 \(v=hu\)，方向差分的截断误差为 \(O(h)\)；有随机噪声时，更近的邻居也可能使导数估计噪声更大，方向覆盖不足还会遗漏完整 Jacobian 的误差。式（9）虽未除以距离，真实输出差中的噪声仍存在。定理给的是模型误差的条件性上界，论文未给出由有限方向的经验损失直接控制完整 Jacobian 误差的一般保证。

en.note: Reading interpretation: the direct intervention is learning environment input derivatives and using them in actor backpropagation, rather than correcting an already computed policy gradient afterward. The Sobolev connection is useful, but joint value/derivative supervision, random projections, and finite differences have precedents; the distinctive contribution is the model-error-to-policy-optimization analysis and two-model usage. Open concern: for \(v=hu\), directional finite differences have \(O(h)\) truncation error; stochastic noise can make derivative estimates noisier for closer neighbors, while limited direction coverage leaves full-Jacobian error unidentified. Although Eq. (9) does not divide by distance, noise remains in observed output differences. The theorems give conditional model-error bounds, without a general guarantee translating the finite-direction empirical loss into full-Jacobian accuracy.

zh.note: 本次阅读判断：可微 WM + 想象 rollout + BPTT 更新 policy 与 SuperMimic 属于同一路线，主要区别是把优化放在执行阶段。部署指离线训练结束后的任务执行或评测，每步冻结 WM、奖励模型和 critic，只更新 actor；真实观测只提供想象起点。离线数据也来自某个策略与环境的交互，数据来源本身不构成思想区别。当前更看好 SuperMimic 将主要优化成本放在训练阶段的路线，尤其考虑实时机器人控制；这是个人研究取舍，两篇任务与评估不同，没有直接比较性能高低。

en.note: Reading assessment: differentiable WM + imagined rollouts + BPTT policy updates follow the same route as SuperMimic; the main distinction is moving optimization into execution. Deployment means task execution or evaluation after offline training: freeze WM, reward, and critic weights and update only the actor at each step, with actual observations supplying imagination start states. Offline data also originates from policy–environment interaction, so data origin is not the conceptual distinction. I currently favor SuperMimic's placement of the main optimization cost in training, especially for real-time robot control. This is a personal research preference; the papers use different tasks and evaluations without a direct performance comparison.

zh.note: 随读理解：VAML 为更新 WM 定义价值相关的误差标准，价值函数类提供评价依据。这里的价值误差指真实转移和模型转移对未来价值期望的影响，不是模型拟合窗口之外缺少的预测。与 SuperMimic 的区别：后者用 8 步自回归预测拟合 WM，再固定模型参数，通过 32 步想象回报与末端 critic 更新 actor；回报梯度穿过 WM 不等于用它更新 WM。我们的优化设想（待验证）：保留多步动力学损失，用真实仿真 rollout 训练参考 value，再约束真实后果与模型后果的价值一致性。示意目标为 \(L_{\mathrm{dyn}}+\lambda|\bar V(f_\omega(s,a),g')-\bar V(s'_{\mathrm{sim}},g')|^2\)；这是单个参考 value 的候选改法，原 VAML 对一类价值函数取最坏误差。更新模型时固定参考 value 参数，保留预测分支对输入状态的梯度，真实目标侧停止梯度。仿真器提供真实状态与奖励，长期价值仍是指定策略、目标和环境条件下的估计；给已有状态估值不要求额外展开 WM。价值一致性不能唯一确定状态转移，也不直接保证动作 Jacobian 准确；用于 SuperMimic 式 BPTT 时，还要验证动作扰动对应的回报变化方向。

en.note: Reading interpretation: VAML defines value-related errors for WM updates, using a value-function class as the evaluation criterion. Value error concerns how true and modeled transitions change future value expectations, rather than missing predictions beyond a model-fitting window. Comparison with SuperMimic: fit the WM with eight-step autoregressive prediction, then freeze its weights and update the actor through 32-step imagined returns with terminal-critic bootstrapping. Passing return gradients through the WM does not mean updating its weights with those gradients. Our optimization idea (to be tested): retain multi-step dynamics loss, train a reference value on actual simulator rollouts, and constrain value consistency between true and modeled outcomes. A candidate objective is \(L_{\mathrm{dyn}}+\lambda|\bar V(f_\omega(s,a),g')-\bar V(s'_{\mathrm{sim}},g')|^2\). This uses one reference value, whereas original VAML takes the worst error over a value-function class. During model updates, freeze reference-value weights, retain prediction-branch input-state gradients, and stop gradients on the true target. The simulator supplies true states and rewards; long-term values remain estimates conditional on a policy, goal, and environment context. Valuing existing states requires no extra WM rollout. Value consistency neither uniquely determines transitions nor directly guarantees accurate action Jacobians; for SuperMimic-style BPTT, also validate return-change directions under action perturbations.

zh.note: 问答复习：WM负责预测候选动作后果，MPPI用预测奖励和末端价值优化动作序列，只执行首个动作并从新观测重规划；这不是只评估actor，也不是推理时更新网络参数。训练按episode混合时间步，评估分别固定控制间隔，预测一步与实际动作保持时间一起改变。固定频率收益的作者解释是快慢动态的多尺度监督与共享学习；要区分“作者提出原因”和“原因已被实验隔离验证”。当前主对比同时改变模型设计与训练分布，缺少相同TAWM架构下固定/混合步长等完整对照。子系统可以是旋转与幅度、构象组内与组间转换等动态成分，不必是独立物理部件；具体例子来自引用书，TAWM没有识别实验任务中的各个子系统。

en.note: Q&A review: the WM predicts candidate-action consequences; MPPI uses predicted rewards and terminal values to optimize a sequence, executes only its first action, and replans from a new observation. Evaluation involves the complete controller, and inference does not mean updating network weights. Training mixes intervals across episodes; evaluations separately fix the control interval, changing both the predicted-step duration and actual action-hold time. The authors explain same-frequency gains through multiscale supervision of shared fast/slow dynamics; proposing that mechanism differs from experimentally isolating it. Main comparisons change both model design and training distribution, without complete fixed/mixed-step controls using an identical TAWM architecture. Subsystems can mean rotation versus amplitude or within-group versus cross-group conformation changes, rather than independent physical parts. These concrete examples come from the cited book; TAWM does not identify the individual subsystems in its benchmark tasks.

zh.note: 本次随读理解：critic 的平方损失学习“参考动作窗口→冻结跟踪器的预期执行回报”；生成器损失保留动作重建项并减去 critic 评分之和，冻结 critic 参数仍允许输入梯度更新 MDM。“物理感知”表示物理执行反馈已进入生成器训练，部署仍输出运动学参考；评分依赖机器人、控制器和采样状态分布。审稿关注：Realism 与训练目标共用 critic，应另测评分与实际回报的相关性，以及沿评分梯度微调动作能否提高真实回报；匹配额外 40 万步训练预算，并加入平滑、降幅等简单对照，以分离额外训练和动作保守化的收益。PhysDiff 对照采用无辅助外力的单次投影，结论范围需随配置限定。表 3 的执行误差支持整体收益，但失败重置的计分方式、动作完成率和跨训练种子波动仍需交代。作者明确提出迭代改善生成器／控制器和物理感知合成数据两条方向；显式约束、执行前验证等属于我们由局限延伸的候选方案。

en.note: Reading interpretation: the critic’s squared loss learns reference-window-to-expected-return prediction for a frozen tracker. Generator training retains reconstruction loss and subtracts summed critic scores; frozen critic weights still allow input gradients to update MDM. Physics-aware means execution feedback enters generator training while deployment still outputs kinematic references; scores depend on robot, tracker, and sampled state distribution. Review concerns: because Realism shares the training critic, separately evaluate score/actual-return correlation and whether small score-gradient motion updates improve real returns. Match the additional 400k training steps and include smoothing or amplitude-reduction controls to isolate extra training and conservative motion changes. PhysDiff uses one projection without helper forces, limiting the comparison’s scope. Table 3 supports whole-system improvements, but reset/failure accounting, clip completion, and across-training-seed variation need clarification. The authors explicitly propose iterative generator/tracker improvement and physics-aware synthetic datasets. Explicit constraints and execution-time validation are our extensions from the limitations.

zh.takeaway: 把学习到的近似逆作用 M 接入 GMRES，改善搜索空间；网络给出预条件向量 z，求解器选择组合系数并形成更新量。
zh.note: 随读复习：预条件处理保持方程解不变，并改变求解形式；对可逆 M，左预条件为 \(MAx=Mb\)。Krylov 是一类方法，GMRES 是其中按最小残差选择解的具体算法。固定线性 M 的左预条件 GMRES 在 \(\mathcal K_m(MA,Mr_0)\) 中构造更新，M 影响整个搜索空间。\(z_0=Mr_0\) 是一次预条件作用的结果；令 \(x_m=x_0+s_m\)，则 \(s_m\) 是求解器选择的更新，第一步有 \(s_1=\alpha z_0\)，系数由 GMRES 决定。JFNK 在外层用 Newton 处理非线性 \(F(u)=0\)，内层用 Krylov 方法解 \(J(u_k)s_k=-F(u_k)\)；Jacobian-free 通过函数差分等方式获得 Jv，预条件器另外提供近似逆作用。本文验证线性 PDE 系统的预条件，未测试完整 JFNK。NAMG 的核心是细层聚合、粗层注意力、返回细层，并结合前后松弛；这些组件的消融支持性能贡献，高低频分工仍是待直接检验的机制解释。标准算法参考：https://netlib.org/templates/templates.html ；JFNK 参考：https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcp.2003.08.010 。

en.takeaway: Use a learned approximate-inverse action M inside GMRES to improve its search space; the network supplies preconditioned vectors z, and the solver chooses combination coefficients and updates.
en.note: Review: preconditioning changes the solution form while preserving the solution; for invertible M, left preconditioning gives \(MAx=Mb\). Krylov denotes a family, and GMRES selects a minimum-residual iterate. With fixed linear M, left-preconditioned GMRES forms updates in \(\mathcal K_m(MA,Mr_0)\), so M changes the full search space. \(z_0=Mr_0\) is one preconditioner application; in \(x_m=x_0+s_m\), \(s_m\) is the selected update, with \(s_1=\alpha z_0\) at the first step and alpha chosen by GMRES. JFNK uses outer Newton iterations for \(F(u)=0\) and an inner Krylov solver for \(J(u_k)s_k=-F(u_k)\). Jacobian-free products obtain Jv through function differences or other means; preconditioning separately supplies approximate-inverse actions. This paper evaluates linear PDE preconditioning, not a complete JFNK system. NAMG aggregates fine features, applies coarse attention, and maps back, with pre/post relaxation. Ablations support component contributions; frequency-specific roles still require direct mechanism measurements. Standard algorithms: https://netlib.org/templates/templates.html ; JFNK: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcp.2003.08.010 .
